description: Synthetic twin of the production tool. Returns invented Signal health with simplified production core fields, marked "sandbox": true. Requires no account, API key, or OAuth flow.

account_id.description: Advertising account ID. Signals reads use the workspace Meta destination when omitted; other tools may require an ID when multiple accounts are active.

days.description: Trailing window in days. One of 7, 30, 90.

months.description: Trailing window of 12 calendar months, in place of days. Offered only where the workspace plan keeps that history and the workspace is set to keep it.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID returned by list_workspaces. Required when this credential reaches multiple workspaces.

name: get_signal_health
title: Get signal health
